why: formal-fixer was required because the reported TapTap performance gate spans four Android devices, release packaging and an ambiguous sampler reading. Zod-validated triage/matrix evidence confirms four FPS failures but does not bind the report to the current ZIP or provide a TapTap threshold/raw trace; therefore 0.02150376 is not treated as a confirmed rendering root cause. RED established both the missing sampling contract and a deterministic engineering bottleneck: GameBootstrap called full redrawCourse on every airborne update, repeatedly clearing and rebuilding all static Graphics geometry. The narrow causal repair separates retained static course Graphics from dynamic blade/feedback Graphics. At a nominal 60 Hz observation window, the source-work proxy changes from 36,000 full-scene redraws and approximately 648,000 repeated static fill/stroke operations over ten minutes to zero; this is not presented as a device FPS measurement. Cold start/first frame, fixed-width safe-area presentation, touch launch/flip, cut, reflection, failure/settlement and replay contracts remain intact. The one permitted Cocos Creator 3.8.8 build used unchanged official plugin 1.2.2 and produced an auditable package; 16/16 tests, performance contract, lint, typecheck, ZIP integrity and metadata pass. Status remains BLOCKED until exact-SHA device/backend natural and performance QA distinguishes real frame performance from sampler failure. Context intentionally omitted: prior runtime-cycle details beyond its package contract, other games/runs, web-lite, WeChat/Douyin, shared factory code, unrelated product systems and any invented FPS threshold.
